description: Placeholder rules for PSSCOC-lite 2025, design and build. Values are taken from the source document (see source and each rule's notes); anything still TODO_VERIFY was not found or does not fit the trigger. Structured facts only; no contract text.
source: docs/contracts: 13-4_psscoc-lite_db.pdf (March 2025), 14-supplement (Appendix). Values extracted 2026-11-24; to be checked by a contracts professional.

rules.obligation: Respond to the interim payment claim (payment response or certificate)
rules.notes: SOP Act cap applies on top (sopa.payment_response). Source: PSSCOC-lite Design and Build 2025 cl 32.2(1): SO issues the Payment Certificate within 14 days of the Payment Claim; it is the deemed Payment Response unless the Employer responds within 14 days (32.2(2)).

rules.obligation: Give notice of a delaying event and claim an extension of time
rules.notes: Source: PSSCOC-lite Design and Build 2025 cl 14.3(1): notice forthwith and in any case within 60 days of the event, with reasons, delay and EOT required. Notice and information within 60 days are conditions precedent.

rules.obligation: Decide on the extension of time claim
rules.notes: Source: PSSCOC-lite Design and Build 2025 cl 14.3(1): SO notifies within 60 days of the notice whether the event does or might entitle an EOT. The extension itself is granted within a reasonable time after sufficient information (14.3(3)).

rules.obligation: Confirm the oral instruction in writing
rules.notes: Source: PSSCOC-lite Design and Build 2025 cl 2.5: Contractor confirms within 3 working days; deemed instruction if not contradicted within the next 3 working days. Working days exclude only Sundays and public holidays: set the project to count Saturdays as working days.

rules.obligation: Object to the instruction, if you dispute it
rules.notes: Source: PSSCOC-lite Design and Build 2025 cl 19.2: if the Contractor considers an instruction requires a variation, he notifies the SO within 14 days of receipt of the instruction. No express condition precedent.

rules.obligation: Give notice of claim or a quotation for the variation
rules.notes: Not found in PSSCOC-lite Design and Build 2025: 19.3 (quotations) is intentionally left blank and the Contractor submits his valuation only on completion of the varied works (20.2(2)(b), no period). Consider rejecting this rule for this form.

Source: PSSCOC-lite Design and Build 2025 cl 20.2(2)(c): SO values (or says what is still to be done) within 30 days of the Contractor's valuation submitted on completion of the varied works. Log that submission as "variation quotation submitted".

rules.obligation: Object to the valuation of the variation, if you dispute it
rules.notes: Not found in PSSCOC-lite Design and Build 2025: 20.2(2)(d) says a disagreement is referred to the SO under 35.1, with no time limit. Consider rejecting this rule for this form.

Trigger mismatch: PSSCOC-lite Design and Build 2025 cl 32.4(1): Final Payment Claim within 30 days of the expiry of the Defects Liability Period or the Date of Substantial Completion, whichever is later, not from the completion certificate. Period left TODO_VERIFY.

Source: PSSCOC-lite Design and Build 2025 cl 18.1(b) (no period) read with 2.6: if the Contractor fails to comply with an instruction within 14 days, or the period stated in it, the Employer may employ others at the Contractor's cost.
